title: Park Kids
metaDescription: Find out about Park Kids at St John's Park, including Sunday groups for children, All In Sundays, and how families can ask questions before visiting.

sections.title: Park Kids
sections.body: Park Kids helps children know they are loved by God, welcomed by the church family, and able to grow in faith in ways that fit their age and stage.

image.alt: Children and families enjoying activities around the churchyard

sections.title: A place for children to belong
sections.body: During term-time Sundays, Park Kids runs during the second part of the service for primary-aged children. The group makes space for Bible stories, prayer, games, creativity, questions, and friendship.

sections.title: Meet Kirsty
sections.intro: Kirsty leads our children and families work and helps Park Kids feel welcoming, safe, and rooted in faith.

cards.title: Kirsty Dronfield
cards.body: Kirsty helps children and families belong, grow in faith, and take part in the life of St John's Park.

sections.title: Faith, friendship, and fun
sections.intro: We want children to feel safe, known, and included as part of the whole church family.

cards.title: Bible and prayer
cards.body: Children explore faith through age-appropriate Bible teaching, simple prayer, and space to ask honest questions.

cards.title: Games and creativity
cards.body: Sessions include playful, practical activities that help children take part and remember what they are learning.

cards.title: Known by name
cards.body: Our leaders work to make Park Kids welcoming, consistent, and caring for children and families.

sections.title: All In Sundays
sections.body: On the first Sunday of the month, every generation worships together in the main service. Children are not just tolerated in the room; they are part of the church family.
points: The service is shaped so children can participate.
Families are welcome even when children make noise or need to move around.

image.alt: Children taking part in a creative activity

sections.title: Want to ask before coming?
sections.body: If your child has particular needs, if you are unsure where they would fit, or if you simply want to know what Sunday will feel like, please get in touch.
